# Aslam Local Visibility

> Organic local visibility for coaches and consultants. I help them get seen, trusted and booked in their own city through Reels, branded design, Google Business Profile optimization and local engagement. No ads, ever. Based in Dhaka, Bangladesh; working remotely with clients worldwide.

## Pages

- [Home](https://bbrfeed.online/): What I do, how it works, the three packages and the FAQ.
- [Pricing](https://bbrfeed.online/pricing/): Presence Builder $500/mo, Visibility Engine $750/mo, City Authority $1200/mo, with a side-by-side comparison.
- [Compare](https://bbrfeed.online/compare/): How organic local visibility compares with big agencies and generic freelancers, plus what each tier includes.
- [Work](https://bbrfeed.online/work/): A spec case study of a Google Business Profile. Client results will be added after the first Founding Clients.
- [About](https://bbrfeed.online/about/): Who I am and how we work together.
- [Contact](https://bbrfeed.online/contact/): Book a free visibility audit or send a message.

## Services

- Presence Builder ($500/month): 8 short-form Reels, 8 branded designs, landing page setup, Google Business Profile optimization.
- Visibility Engine ($750/month): Everything in Presence Builder, plus Reddit community engagement, LinkedIn management and a monthly performance report.
- City Authority ($1200/month): Everything in Visibility Engine, plus a full professional website build and an advanced content strategy.

## Founding Client offer

4 spots: the Tier 2 (Visibility Engine) package for $500/month for the first 3 months, in exchange for a testimonial and permission to use results as a case study.

## Notes

- No paid advertising is offered or used. All work is organic.
- Typical timeline: more profile views and engagement within about 30 days; local search ranking improvement within about 60-90 days.
